title: The Woman and the Dragon

questions.question: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the ____, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:1 (ESV): "And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars."

questions.question: She was ____ and was crying out in birth pains and the agony of giving birth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:2 (ESV): "She was pregnant and was crying out in birth pains and the agony of giving birth."

questions.question: And another sign appeared in heaven: behold, a great red ____, with seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven diadems.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:3 (ESV): "And another sign appeared in heaven: behold, a great red dragon, with seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven diadems."

questions.question: His tail swept down a third of the ____ of heaven and cast them to the earth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:4 (ESV): "His tail swept down a third of the stars of heaven and cast them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she bore her child he might devour it."

questions.question: And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she bore her child he might ____ it.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:4 (ESV): "His tail swept down a third of the stars of heaven and cast them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she bore her child he might devour it."

questions.question: She gave birth to a male child, one who is to rule all the nations with a rod of ____, but her child was caught up to God and to his throne,
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:5 (ESV): "She gave birth to a male child, one who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron, but her child was caught up to God and to his throne,"

questions.question: and the woman fled into the ____, where she has a place prepared by God, in which she is to be nourished for 1,260 days.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:6 (ESV): "and the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, in which she is to be nourished for 1,260 days."

questions.question: Now ____ arose in heaven, ____ and his angels fighting against the dragon.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:7 (ESV): "Now war arose in heaven, Michael and his angels fighting against the dragon. And the dragon and his angels fought back,"

questions.question: And the great dragon was thrown down, that ancient ____, who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world...
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:9 (ESV): "And the great dragon was thrown down, that ancient serpent, who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world—he was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him."

questions.question: And they have conquered him by the blood of the ____ and by the word of their testimony, for they loved not their lives even unto death.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:11 (ESV): "And they have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, for they loved not their lives even unto death."

questions.question: Therefore, rejoice, O heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to you, O earth and sea, for the devil has come down to you in great ____...
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:12 (ESV): "Therefore, rejoice, O heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to you, O earth and sea, for the devil has come down to you in great wrath, because he knows that his time is short!"

questions.question: But the woman was given the two wings of the great ____ so that she might fly from the serpent into the wilderness, to the place where she is to be nourished...
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:14 (ESV): "But the woman was given the two wings of the great eagle so that she might fly from the serpent into the wilderness, to the place where she is to be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time."

questions.question: The serpent poured ____ like a river out of his mouth after the woman, to sweep her away with a flood.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:15 (ESV): "The serpent poured water like a river out of his mouth after the woman, to sweep her away with a flood."

questions.question: But the ____ came to the help of the woman, and the ____ opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:16 (ESV): "But the earth came to the help of the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had poured from his mouth."

questions.question: Then the dragon became furious with the woman and went off to make ____ on the rest of her offspring...
questions.explanation: Revelation 12:17 (ESV): "Then the dragon became furious with the woman and went off to make war on the rest of her offspring, on those who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus."

key_verse_text: And they have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, for they loved not their lives even unto death.
